note: One entry per publishable image. .github/workflows/publish-image.yml builds each context and pushes docker.io/nikcio/<name>:v<release> (plus :latest) when a release is published (requires DOCKERHUB_USERNAME + DOCKERHUB_TOKEN repo secrets). Pair every image with a published kit spec that pins docker.io/nikcio/<name>:vX.Y.Z and register that spec in .release-please-config.json (extra-files) so releases bump it.
